description: Get a media block pipeline template for a specific use case. Returns the list of required blocks and how to connect them, along with C# code to build the pipeline.

useCase.description: Use case description. Available templates: 'rtsp-to-mp4' (record network camera to file), 'webcam-preview' (show webcam on screen), 'webcam-to-rtmp' (stream webcam live), 'file-transcode' (convert video file format), 'screen-to-hls' (screen capture to HLS stream), 'multi-source-mix' (mix multiple video sources), 'audio-only-capture' (record audio to file), 'ndi-output' (stream via NDI protocol)

name: get_pipeline_template
